rafaelle_nistico: At the depot, Jakub Nistico had practised answering to his name. At R-F20, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F20 and grazed Jakub Nistico's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Clement Wanter of the Hegemony (@wanter_cz).
